text: ずっと　ゆくと　きのみの　もりが　あるのよ

structure.en: if you keep going all the way

structure.jp: きのみの　もりが　あるのよ

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'if', for something that always follows. ずっと　ゆくと = 'if you keep going'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a soft, womanly way of saying のだ, used when explaining something to the listener. あるのよ = 'there is, you know'.
